Kia launches premium Sorento SUV in India at Rs 27.99 lakh

Kia Motor India introduced a new premium Sorento SUV priced at Rs 27.99 lakh. The Sorento is equipped with a hybrid powertrain. The launch was reported by Deccan Chronicle and Times Now. Times Now published a side‑by‑side price and specification comparison with the Toyota Fortuner. Times Now also listed five key details about the Sorento's features and specifications. No other outlets provided additional commentary.
